summary:
“Woah!” Irish chuckled ironically, snatching his ankle and yanking him back across the floor, “Be careful where you're going or you're gonna die too early.”
Too early. Conan thought. Too early.
He was going to die then. No question about that. The only question was when.
Or: What would happen if Conan's luck ran out at the end of The Raven Chaser? What if he hadn't managed to get outside onto the balcony where Irish would eventually be shot? He's a heck of an opponent, and he's allowed to actually be an antagonist for more than 5 minutes.
